name: Futari de Marvel Shichaimasu! ~Kinou no Teki wa Kyou mo Koibito!?~
original_name: ふたりでマーヴルしちゃいます！～昨日の敵は今日も恋人！？～
source:
Main character gets to protect two girls from molesters on his way to school. Next day these girls join his class as transfer students and even get seats next to him. A fierce battle for his attention continues each day. At the same time PC components shop owner asks protagonist to defend the world from evil forces. He is supported by transfer students who turn out to be justice sailor warriors. The competition between girls comes to the new stage with their supernatural forces revealed.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在上学途中挺身而出，从色狼手中救下了两名少女。谁知到了第二天，这两名少女竟双双作为转校生分进了他的班级，甚至就坐在他的邻座，日复一日围绕他的关注展开激烈争宠。与此同时，一家电脑配件店的老板突然委托主人公挺身守护世界、对抗邪恶势力，而从旁协助他的正是那两位转校生——原来她们的真实身份竟是代表正义的水手服美少女战士！随着超凡力量浮出水面，两位少女之间的恋爱争夺战也迈入了全新阶段。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
